name: std::list<T,Allocator>::begin, std::list<T,Allocator>::cbegin
intro:
Returns an iterator to the first element of the list.

If the list is empty, the returned iterator will be equal to end().

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: libc++ backports cbegin() to C++98 mode.

examples.output:
1 2 4 8 16
Sum of nums: 31
First fruit: orange
list 'empty' is indeed empty.

summary: Returns an iterator to the first element of the list.
